premise: Bee comes home from Flower with yellow socks of dust and Ladybug wants to brush them clean; Bee shows her the dust rubbing off on the next flower, and days later a seed pod where she visited.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So wonder at a real thing, turned: the mess is the magic, and the messenger takes no credit.
lesson: Small messy jobs can make big new things.
learning: Bees carry yellow pollen from flower to flower, and that is how a flower makes its seeds.

en-US.title: Bee's Yellow Socks
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.3} Bee {bee:pulse} came back from Flower with yellow socks. [surprised] Yellow knees, yellow dust all over her fuzzy tummy. You are covered! said Ladybug. {ladybug:hop} Hold still. {sfx:brush} Brush, brush. No, no! said Bee, and wriggled away. {bee:wobble x2} I need it! [curious] You need dust? said Ladybug. Watch, said Bee. She flew to Flower {flower:pulse} and landed, and rubbed. Yellow came off. New yellow got on. Then she flew to the next flower. Yellow off, yellow on. Butterfly {butterfly:wobble} watched too. That is the flowers talking to each other, said Bee. I am the messenger. [giggles] A messenger with yellow socks, giggled Ladybug. Days went by. And where Bee had rubbed, Flower {flower:glow} grew something new. A little green pod, full of seeds. {flower:sparkle} [gasps] Did you do that? said Ladybug. Flower did it, said Bee. I only carried the yellow. [happily] And she flew off to get her socks dirty again.

es-ES.title: Los calcetines amarillos de Abeja
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} {butterfly:float loop 0.3} Abeja {bee:pulse} volvió de Flor con calcetines amarillos. [surprised] Polvo amarillo por toda la barriguita peluda. ¡Estás llena de polvo!, dijo Mariquita. {ladybug:hop} Quieta. {sfx:brush} Frota, frota. ¡No, no!, dijo Abeja, y se escapó meneándose. {bee:wobble x2} ¡Lo necesito! [curious] ¿Necesitas polvo?, dijo Mariquita. Mira, dijo Abeja. Voló hasta Flor {flower:pulse} y aterrizó, y se frotó. Se le cayó amarillo. Se le pegó amarillo nuevo. Luego, a la siguiente flor. Amarillo que cae, amarillo que se pega. Mariposa {butterfly:wobble} también miraba. Son las flores hablando entre ellas, dijo Abeja. Yo soy la mensajera. [giggles] Una mensajera con calcetines amarillos, rio Mariquita. Pasaron los días. Y donde Abeja se había frotado, a Flor {flower:glow} le creció algo nuevo. Una vainita verde, llena de semillas. {flower:sparkle} [gasps] ¿Eso lo has hecho tú?, dijo Mariquita. Lo ha hecho Flor, dijo Abeja. Yo solo llevé el amarillo. [happily] Y se fue volando a ensuciarse los calcetines otra vez.

brush.prompt: tiny quick brushing strokes, like a small brush dusting fuzz, soft and light
